name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
summary: A scheme that provides credit-linked subsidy, branding and marketing support to micro food processing enterprises to help them formalise, upgrade technology and grow.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible micro enterprise receives a credit-linked subsidy of 35 percent of the project cost, up to a maximum of Rs. 10 lakh.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the district level.
